search.title: Zebra
search.snippet: The zebra is an African equine with black & white stripes; three living species are recognised.

search.title: Café (film)
search.snippet: Café is a film about a small coffee shop & the people who meet there each morning.

search.title: Plains zebra
search.snippet: The plains zebra & its kins, the most widespread équidé of all, roam the savanna.

search.title: Grévy's zebra
search.snippet: Grévy's zebra & its habitat: the largest living wild equid, found in Kenya and Ethiopia.

search.title: Zebra crossing
search.snippet: A zebra crossing is a type of pedestrian crossing & is marked by alternating stripes.

search.title: Mountain zebra
search.snippet: The mountain zebra & its subspecies live in south-western Africa.

search.title: Zebra mussel
search.snippet: The zebra mussel is a small freshwater mussel & an invasive species.

search.title: Zebra finch
search.snippet: The zebra finch & its song have been studied extensively.
